title: Run
description: Full record of one generation: the request plus all four artifacts plus planted/found bug data. Returned by POST /api/runs and GET /api/runs/{id}.

parallelVersion.description: Artifact 2: multithreaded, carries the planted bugs, no comments pointing at them.

parallelVersionFixed.description: Corrected version, produced up front alongside everything else. The 'Fix Bugs' UI action reveals this — it never triggers a new generation.

testHarness.description: Artifact 3: drives both versions and compares them.

bugReport.description: Artifact 4, from the blind analyser. Compare against plantedBugs to see what was found vs. planted — that comparison is computed by the client, not stored here.

fixed.description: Whether 'Fix Bugs' has been revealed for this run. Starts false; set via PATCH /api/runs/{id}.
